title: In silico saturation mutagenesis of cancer genes
summary: 185 machine-learning models built from observed tumour mutations classified driver versus passenger mutations in cancer genes and outperformed experimental saturation mutagenesis in the cited comparisons.
organization: Institute for Research in Biomedicine (IRB Barcelona)

source_review.scope: Europe PMC metadata and abstract only; Methods not read.

evidence.tested: Benchmark against experimental saturation mutagenesis per abstract.
evidence.ai_role: Models scored every possible mutation in the studied genes.
